cavity\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\t# Center the tab along Y, position it adjacent to the main body\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length - {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DEU65uRQr98nxrgCQk3jv7","type":"tool_result","content":"# nurb design doctrine\n\nPrinted via `nurb rules`. This file is the single source; harness files point at it\nrather than repeating it.\n\nThese are standing rules for FDM-printed parts, and several are vetoes rather than\npreferences. Most of them are physics, so they outlive any particular CAD kernel. The\nones that are specific to OCCT are marked as such and were measured, not reasoned.\n\n## The part contract\n\n```python\nfrom nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef dispenser(width=80.0, height=120.0, wall=2.0, draft=False):\n    body = Box(width, height, wall)\n    if draft:\n        return body\n    bed = body.bounding_box().min.Z\n    keep = body.edges().filter_by(lambda e: e.bounding_box().min.Z > bed)\n    return polish(body, keep, 1.0)\n```\n\nKeyword defaults are the parameters. That one declaration feeds the agent, the CLI, the\nviewer, the tests, and any future configurator. Never add a parallel `PARAMS` dict; the\ntwo would drift.\n\n**Write a continuous dimension as a float.** The type of a default is the only thing\nthat says whether a value is a count or a measurement, and the viewer reads it: an `int`\ndefault gets a slider that steps by one, a `float` default one that moves continuously.\n`bracket_count=4` is a count and `chamfer_size=1.0` is a millimetre, so the trailing\n`.0` is doing work. Nothing else has to be declared, and there is no annotation to keep\nin sync, because the type is already there in the signature.\n\n`draft` is optional and injected by the runtime, never passed by a caller. When it is\ntrue, skip the polish pass. It is worth about 20% on a real part, not the 18x a cube\nsuggests.\n\nReturn one solid. cavity\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\t# Center the tab along Y, position it adjacent to the main body\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length - tab_thickness) / 2\n\tmount_tab = mount_tab.translate(Vector(body_width, tab_y_offset, 0))\n\n\t# Combine main part with mounting tab\n\t# Account for Box centering: main_body goes from -body_width/2 to +body_width/2\n\t# Tab should start where main_body ends, so translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2\n\tcombined = main_part + mount_tab\n\n\t# Create through-hole in the mounting tab (vertical, 4.2mm diameter)\n\thole = Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, tab_thickness + 0.2)\n\t# Position hole at center of mounting tab\n\thole_x = body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2\n\thole_y = tab_y_offset\n\thole_z = 0  # Aligned with tab center\n\thole = hole.translate(Vector(hole_x, hole_y, hole_z))\n\n\t# Subtract hole from combined part\n\tfinal_part = combined - hole\n\n\t# Polish exterior edges (but channel interior stays square)\n\tbed = final_part.bounding_box().min.Z\n\tkeep = final_part.edges().filter_by(lambda e: e.bounding_box().min.Z > bed)\n\tfinal_part = polish(final_part, keep, 1.0)\n\n\treturn final_part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":36,"oldLines":9,"newStart":36,"newLines":11,"lines":[" ","   # Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)","   mount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)","-  # Center the tab along Y, position it adjacent to the main body","+  # Position tab adjacent to main body (account for Box centering)","+  # Main body right edge is at body_width/2, tab left edge should start there","+  # Tab is centered, so left edge is at -tab_length/2, translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2","   tab_y_offset = (channel_length - cavity\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\t# Position tab adjacent to main body (account for Box centering)\n\t# Main body right edge is at body_width/2, tab left edge should start there\n\t# Tab is centered, so left edge is at -tab_length/2, translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length - tab_thickness) / 2\n\tmount_tab = mount_tab.translate(Vector(body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2, tab_y_offset, 0))\n\n\t# Combine main part with mounting tab\n\t# Account for Box centering: main_body goes from -body_width/2 to +body_width/2\n\t# Tab should start where main_body ends, so translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2\n\tcombined = main_part + mount_tab\n\n\t# Create through-hole in the mounting tab (vertical, 4.2mm diameter)\n\thole = Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, tab_thickness + 0.2)\n\t# Position hole at center of mounting tab\n\thole_x = body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2\n\thole_y = tab_y_offset\n\thole_z = 0  # Aligned with tab center\n\thole = hole.translate(Vector(hole_x, hole_y, hole_z))\n\n\t# Subtract hole from combined part\n\tfinal_part = combined - (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ee67652d-c996-4bd8-b5fa-f7149a880fa3","uuid":"d9768620-11ee-43d7-a88b-469d935901af","timestamp":"2026-08-02T11:27:44.612Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"<workspace>/evals/results/claude-haiku-low/trial_3/project/parts/cable_clip.py","oldString":"\t# Combine base and walls to create the main structure\n\tmain_part = base + left_wall + right_wall","newString":"\t# Combine base and walls to create the main structure\n\tmain_part = (base + left_wall + right_wall).clean()","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter: float = 8.0):\n\t\"\"\"Screw-down cable clip for bundled cables.\n\n\tbundle_diameter: diameter of the cable bundle to hold, in mm\n\t\"\"\"\n\t# Fixed dimensions\n\twall_thickness = 2.4\n\tbase_thickness = 3.0\n\tchannel_length = 12.0\n\ttab_length = 10.0\n\ttab_thickness = 3.0\n\thole_diameter = 4.2\n\n\t# Derived dimensions\n\tchannel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4\n\tchannel_depth = bundle_diameter\n\n\t# Total body dimensions\n\tbody_width = wall_thickness + channel_width + wall_thickness\n\tbody_height = base_thickness + channel_depth\n\n\t# Build the channel structure by unioning the base and walls\n\t# This avoids sliver faces from subtraction operations\n\tbase = Box(body_width, channel_length, base_thickness)\n\n\t# Left wall: positioned to sit flush on left side of base, extending upward\n\tleft_wall = Box(wall_thickness, channel_length, channel_depth)\n\tleft_x = (-body_width / 2 + wall_thickness / 2)  # Center of left wall\n\tleft_z = (base_thickness + channel_depth) / 2    # Center Z position (sits on top of base)\n\tleft_wall = left_wall.translate(Vector(left_x, 0, left_z))\n\n\t# Right wall: positioned to sit flush on right side of base, extending upward\n\tright_wall = Box(wall_thickness, channel_length, channel_depth)\n\tright_x = (body_width / 2 - wall_thickness / 2)  # Center of right wall\n\tright_z = left_z  # Same height as left wall\n\tright_wall = right_wall.translate(Vector(right_x, 0, right_z))\n\n\t# Combine base and walls to create the main structure\n\tmain_part = base + left_wall + right_wall\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\t# Position tab adjacent to main body (account for Box centering)\n\t# Main body right edge is at body_width/2, tab left edge should start there\n\t# Tab is centered, so left edge is at -tab_length/2, translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length - tab_thickness) / 2\n\tmount_tab = mount_tab.translate(Vector(body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2, tab_y_offset, 0))\n\n\t# Combine main part with mounting tab\n\t# Account for Box centering: main_body goes from -body_width/2 to +body_width/2\n\t# Tab should start where main_body ends, so translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2\n\tcombined = main_part + mount_tab\n\n\t# Create through-hole in the mounting tab (vertical, 4.2mm diameter)\n\thole = Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, tab_thickness + 0.2)\n\t# Position hole at center of mounting tab\n\thole_x = body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2\n\thole_y = tab_y_offset\n\thole_z = 0  # Aligned with tab center\n\thole = hole.translate(Vector(hole_x, hole_y, hole_z))\n\n\t# Subtract hole from combined part\n\tfinal_part = combined - hole\n\n\t# Polish exterior edges, excluding channel interior (concave edges must stay square)\n\t# Only polish edges that are above the bed and not in the channel interior\n\tbed = final_part.bounding_box().min.Z\n\tconcave = set(concave_edges(final_part))\n\n\tdef should_polish(edge):\n\t\t# Don't polish bed-level edges or concave channel edges\n\t\tif edge.bounding_box().min.Z <= bed + 0.1:\n\t\t\treturn False\n\t\tif edge in concave:\n\t\t\treturn False\n\t\treturn True\n\n\tkeep = final_part.edges().filter_by(should_polish)\n\tfinal_part = polish(final_part, keep, 1.0)\n\n\treturn final_part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":40,"oldLines":7,"newStart":40,"newLines":7,"lines":["   right_wall = right_wall.translate(Vector(right_x, 0, right_z))"," ","   # Combine base and walls to create the main structure","-  main_part = base + left_wall + right_wall","+  main_part = (base + left_wall + right_wall).clean()"," ","   # Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)","   mount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

cavity","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter: float = 8.0):\n\t\"\"\"Screw-down cable clip for bundled cables.\n\n\tbundle_diameter: diameter of the cable bundle to hold, in mm\n\t\"\"\"\n\t# Fixed dimensions\n\twall_thickness = 2.4\n\tbase_thickness = 3.0\n\tchannel_length = 12.0\n\ttab_length = 10.0\n\ttab_thickness = 3.0\n\thole_diameter = 4.2\n\n\t# Derived dimensions\n\tchannel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4\n\tchannel_depth = bundle_diameter\n\n\t# Total body dimensions\n\tbody_width = wall_thickness + channel_width + wall_thickness\n\tbody_height = base_thickness + channel_depth\n\n\t# Build the U-channel by extruding a 2D profile\n\t# This avoids junction artifacts from boolean operations\n\twith BuildSketch() as profile:\n\t\t# Create U-shaped cross-section (in X-Z plane, extruded along Y)\n\t\t# Bottom base rectangle\n\t\tprofile.sketch.Rectangle(body_width, base_thickness)\n\t\t# Left wall\n\t\twith profile.push(Vector(-body_width/2 + wall_thickness/2, base_thickness/2)):\n\t\t\tprofile.sketch.Rectangle(wall_thickness, channel_depth, mode=Mode.ADD)\n\t\t# Right wall\n\t\twith profile.push(Vector(body_width/2 - wall_thickness/2, base_thickness/2)):\n\t\t\tprofile.sketch.Rectangle(wall_thickness, channel_depth, mode=Mode.ADD)\n\n\tmain_part = extrude(profile.sketch, channel_length)\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length - tab_thickness) / 2\n\tmount_tab = mount_tab.translate(Vector(body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2, tab_y_offset, 0))\n\n\t# Combine main part with mounting tab\n\t# Account for Box centering: main_body goes from -body_width/2 to +body_width/2\n\t# Tab should start where main_body ends, so translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2\n\tcombined = main_part + mount_tab\n\n\t# Create through-hole in the mounting tab (vertical, 4.2mm diameter)\n\thole = Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, tab_thickness + 0.2)\n\t# Position hole at center of mounting tab\n\thole_x = body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2\n\thole_y = tab_y_offset\n\thole_z = 0  # Aligned with tab center\n\thole = hole.translate(Vector(hole_x, hole_y, hole_z))\n\n\t# Subtract hole from combined part\n\tfinal_part = combined - cavity","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter: float = 8.0):\n\t\"\"\"Screw-down cable clip for bundled cables.\n\n\tbundle_diameter: diameter of the cable bundle to hold, in mm\n\t\"\"\"\n\t# Fixed dimensions\n\twall_thickness = 2.4\n\tbase_thickness = 3.0\n\tchannel_length = 12.0\n\ttab_length = 10.0\n\ttab_thickness = 3.0\n\thole_diameter = 4.2\n\n\t# Derived dimensions\n\tchannel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4\n\tchannel_depth = bundle_diameter\n\n\t# Total body dimensions\n\tbody_width = wall_thickness + channel_width + wall_thickness\n\tbody_height = base_thickness + channel_depth\n\n\t# Use cavity subtraction with proper overlap to create clean boolean operations\n\tmain_body = Box(body_width, channel_length, body_height)\n\n\t# Create channel cavity that extends beyond the walls to ensure clean cuts\n\t# Extend in X to go past both walls, extend in Y to reach edges, extend slightly in Z\n\tcavity = Box(channel_width + 2 * wall_thickness + 0.1, channel_length + 0.1, channel_depth + 0.1)\n\t# Center the cavity in X, keep it centered in Y, position at top of base in Z\n\tcavity = cavity.translate(Vector(0, 0, base_thickness - 0.05))\n\n\t# Subtract cavity to create the channel\n\tmain_part = (main_body - cavity).clean()\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length - tab_thickness) / 2\n\tmount_tab = mount_tab.translate(Vector(body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2, tab_y_offset, 0))\n\n\t# Combine main part with mounting tab\n\t# Account for Box centering: main_body goes from -body_width/2 to +body_width/2\n\t# Tab should start where main_body ends, so translate by body_width/2 + tab_length/2\n\tcombined = main_part + mount_tab\n\n\t# Create through-hole in the mounting tab (vertical, 4.2mm diameter)\n\thole = Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, tab_thickness + 0.2)\n\t# Position hole at center of mounting tab\n\thole_x = body_width / 2 + tab_length / 2\n\thole_y = tab_y_offset\n\thole_z = 0  # Aligned with tab center\n\thole = hole.translate(Vector(hole_x, hole_y, hole_z))\n\n\t# Subtract hole from combined part\n\tfinal_part = combined - hole\n\n\t# Clean up the geometry to remove sliver faces\n\tfinal_part = final_part.clean()\n\n\t# Polish exterior edges (but not the channel interior which must stay square)\n\tbed = final_part.bounding_box().min.Z\n\tkeep_edges = final_part.edges().filter_by(lambda e: e.bounding_box().min.Z > bed + 0.1)\n\tconcave = concave_edges(final_part)\n\n\t# Filter out concave edges from the set to polish\n\tedges_to_polish = [e for e in keep_edges if e not in concave]\n\n\tif edges_to_polish:\n\t\tfinal_part = polish(final_part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)\n\n\treturn final_part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":23,"oldLines":17,"newStart":23,"newLines":16,"lines":["   body_width = wall_thickness + channel_width + wall_thickness","   body_height = base_thickness + channel_depth"," ","-  # Use cavity subtraction with proper overlap to create clean boolean operations","+  # Use cavity subtraction to create the channel","   main_body = Box(body_width, channel_length, body_height)"," ","-  # Create channel cavity that extends beyond the walls to ensure clean cuts","-  # Extend in X to go past both walls, extend in Y to reach edges, extend slightly in Z","-  cavity = Box(channel_width + 2 * wall_thickness + 0.1, channel_length + 0.1, channel_depth + 0.1)","-  # Center the cavity in X, keep it centered in Y, position at top of base in Z","-  cavity = cavity.translate(Vector(0, 0, base_thickness - wall_thickness/2, 0, base_thickness/2 + channel_depth/2))\n\n\t# Combine base and walls, then clean up\n\tmain_part = base + left_wall + right_wall\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length - wall_thickness/2, 0, base_thickness/2 + channel_depth/2))\n\n\t# Combine base and walls\n\tmain_part = base + left_wall + right_wall\n\n\t# Create mounting tab (extends from outside of right wall)\n\tmount_tab = Box(tab_length, tab_thickness, tab_thickness)\n\ttab_y_offset = (channel_length -
